title: 2048 X2 Legends
desc: 2048 X2 Legends gives the classic number-merge idea a shooting twist. Fire blocks into matching values, combine upward and manage the board before the available space disappears. Boosters help when a perfect merge is just out of reach.
howto: Aim a block toward another block with the same number.
Shoot to combine them into a higher value.
Keep matching values available on the board.
Use boosters only when space is genuinely tight.
Reach the highest number you can before running out of room.
tips: Keep one low block available as a merge anchor.
Do not chase a large number while the center fills.
Check the whole board for a chain before every shot.
